PCI_DSS_v4.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0
mandates: Requirement 10: Log and Monitor All Access to System Components and Cardholder Data
Requirement 11: Test Security of Systems and Networks Regularly

GDPR.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU 2016/679)
mandates: Article 33: Notification of a personal data breach to the supervisory authority
Article 34: Communication of a personal data breach to the data subject

GLBA.name: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act (Financial Modernization Act)
mandates: Safeguards Rule: Maintain administrative, technical, and physical safeguards for NPI
Pretexting Provisions: Protection against obtaining customer info under false pretenses

BCBS_239.name: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (Risk Data Aggregation)
mandates: Principle 3: Accuracy and Integrity of Aggregated Risk Data
